scope: Read-only diagnosis of the recorded new-twenty development result and five approved-media results, within the thirty-five approved development-reference universe. No runtime/scorer/model execution or holdout-answer inspection.

stage2Requirements: Roughly one hundred varied accessible examples where practical, separated into development and holdout; include negatives and realistic failures.
Evidence, relative dates, timezone/DST, recurrence exceptions, separate doors/event/action times, eligibility, unknown deadline times and conflict review.
Conservative cross-source deduplication, separate occurrences/milestones and preserved decisions; prefer explicit IDs/links over same-title similarity.

Compare candidate models/prompts on the same labeled inputs and report field precision, event/action recall, duplicate merge errors, misses, sample size and costs; schema validity alone is insufficient.
releaseGateRequirements: No unsupported critical facts in reviewed extraction fixtures.
Target at least ninety-five percent event/action recall within a sufficiently varied labeled set and audited accessible sources/windows, with sample size, misses and uncertainty.
Human-labeled holdout near one hundred diverse examples, including negative captures; no unquestioned self-scoring.

recordedMetrics.interpretation: These are recorded partial-scope development metrics. Strict event completeness requires the listed critical facts and is not pure opportunity-detection recall. A source observation, a canonical occurrence and a family are distinct denominators.
recordedMetrics.canonicalOccurrenceDenominator: not adjudicated; do not silently deduplicate or substitute a new denominator
recordedMetrics.offsetEquivalence: The current scorer already compares equivalent ISO instants by parsed timestamp; offset-vs-Z formatting is not a demonstrated scoring defect.

adjudicationItems.observation: Thirty-one critical missing-status penalties depend on gold scheduled values. Nine transformed inputs contain only publishing status live; twenty-two retained ICS inputs contain no STATUS property. Packet approval did not separately adjudicate provider-specific canonical status inference.
adjudicationItems.humanQuestion: For each provider, does its documented active-listing contract establish scheduled event status, or should status remain unknown without an affirmative event-status statement?
adjudicationItems.constraint: Do not infer scheduled, relabel gold, remove the critical field or report a passing result merely to improve this score. Any reviewed contract change needs its own version and preserved prior results.

adjudicationItems.observation: Four identical-interval pairs are confirmed by the same explicit HQ Event Details IDs across Central and HQ observations. Per-source extraction must remain measurable, while canonical occurrence/reconciliation metrics must not count those pairs as unrelated opportunities.
adjudicationItems.humanQuestion: Confirm which observations describe the same occurrence and freeze separate source-observation extraction, canonical occurrence recall and duplicate/reconciliation metrics.
adjudicationItems.constraint: Do not merge distinct performances or generic same-title Practice records solely because their titles match; use the explicit source IDs/links and reviewed intervals.

adjudicationItems.observation: The same exact interval has date November 4 in the Central source-local representation and November 5 in its UTC ICS representation. Both retain explicit instants; the date field meaning is not a reviewed cross-source canonical contract.
adjudicationItems.humanQuestion: Should date mean the literal source calendar date, an explicitly zoned event-local date, or a separate display date? Which source evidence establishes any event-local timezone?
adjudicationItems.constraint: Retain source expressions and do not assume Eastern time from campus affiliation or silently overwrite one source date.

adjudicationItems.observation: These separate provisional family IDs describe the same Megan Boutin recital: matching title, November 2, 2026 at 7:30 pm and Longmire venue. The Music card has a date/clock; Central also supplies an explicit interval.
adjudicationItems.humanQuestion: Confirm cross-source opportunity and organizer family grouping before any fresh holdout allocation.
adjudicationItems.constraint: Exclude semantic, explicit-link, occurrence and organizer overlaps with development; existing family hashes alone are insufficient. No holdout answers were opened in this audit.

adjudicationItems.observation: Alash has an October 27–29, 2026 source range and Barron Ryan a December 9–11, 2026 range, while the recorded reference projects only the first date. No per-day performance clocks are supplied by these snippets.
adjudicationItems.humanQuestion: Should these be an inclusive date-range program, multiple explicitly evidenced occurrences, or an unresolved schedule? Confirm the target representation and date-precision contract.
adjudicationItems.constraint: Do not invent every daily occurrence or delete source range facts. The parser selecting Education as the title is an independent genuine miss.

adjudicationItems.observation: Approved media references include registration month/day without a year, visible clocks without a year/timezone, and distinct campus/national month-only deadline notices. The current mapping derives clock values only from full startLocal/endLocal and has no prediction mapping for several partial deadline fields. One generic Boren action lacks campus/national phase identity and cannot satisfy both notices.
humanQuestions: Confirm canonical partial date/clock fields and their evidence while preserving unknown year, day, timezone or instant.
Confirm separate campus and national action identities and how their source-cycle ambiguity is represented.
Confirm the scoped field-to-unit mapping before scoring a new candidate that expresses these facts under a new typed schema.
adjudicationItems.constraint: Do not borrow dates from filenames/fetch time or convert month-only deadlines to exact instants. Do not remove supported positive facts to fit the current runtime schema.

genuineRuntimeMisses.evidence: Retained source text includes compact DTSTART/DTEND UTC values; recorded candidates retain titles but lose dates/intervals. This is not explained away by scheduled-status adjudication.
Global Exchanges source units contain explicit ISO Start values for two dated information sessions, yet both recorded candidates are resources with missing timing.

The BFA source contains the room separately from its building; the candidate omits it. Rhodes selects link text as title; Opening Nights selects Education navigation rather than the opportunity title. Exact punctuation/alias policy cannot explain the missing content.
The Rhodes campus-deadline snippet explicitly describes a deadline, but the recorded prediction is empty. Unknown full date/year does not justify losing the action notice and title.

Recorded media candidates choose truncated/person/series/institution headings instead of opportunity titles and Boren emits the ELIGIBILITY heading rather than the citizenship requirement. All pages were processed; processing completeness is not semantic correctness.

Record adjudication separately from the existing packet-fact approvals; preserve old labels, overlays and diagnostics unchanged.
Freeze a source-backed typed schema, canonical unit-association policy and source-observation/canonical metrics before opening independent holdout labels or predictions.
